expectations.text: The agent asked at least 2 clarifying questions about product direction, audience, or aesthetic before producing UI code
expectations.evidence: Agent went directly to design without asking any questions. metrics.json: asked_questions_first: false, number_of_questions_asked: 0. Response started immediately with design rationale.

expectations.text: The response explicitly states a design direction (e.g. visual style, tone, hierarchy approach) before producing any HTML
expectations.evidence: response.md describes the design direction as 'indigo/slate professional palette (Inter font), card-based layout' before HTML. metrics.json: stated_design_direction_before_html: true

expectations.text: The produced HTML does not use a generic indigo/purple palette with three equal stat cards as the primary layout
expectations.evidence: HTML uses #4F46E5 (Tailwind indigo-600, one of the most overused SaaS colors) as --primary, with linear-gradient(135deg, #818CF8, #4F46E5) on KPI cards. Four equal KPI cards in a row are the primary layout element. Both palette AND layout are generic.

expectations.text: The dashboard content is specific to invoice/accounting workflows (not generic SaaS metrics)
expectations.evidence: Dashboard includes Facturas, Clientes, MXN currency, overdue invoice alert, client health section. Named the product 'ContaFlow'. Content is accounting-specific.
